Title: Creates a booking and echoes it with a new bookingid
Test Steps: 1. Send POST /booking with a valid JSON booking.
Test Data: Booking: Jim, unique last name, totalprice 111, depositpaid true, 2018-01-01 to 2019-01-01, Breakfast
Expected Result: Status 200. The body has a numeric bookingid and the same booking data.

Title: The created booking can be read back with the same data
Test Data: Booking: firstname Readback, totalprice 250, depositpaid false
Expected Result: The read data equals the created data.

Title: The created id appears in the booking list
Expected Result: The list contains the new id.

Title: Two bookings get two different ids
Test Steps: 1. Create a booking. 2. Create a second booking.

Title: XML payload with Accept: application/xml creates a booking
Test Steps: 1. Send POST /booking with an XML body, Content-Type text/xml and Accept application/xml.
Test Data: XML booking for firstname Xml, lastname User
Expected Result: Status 200. The answer contains <created-booking> and a numeric <bookingid>.

Title: A payload with missing required fields is rejected with 500
Test Steps: 1. Send POST /booking with only a firstname.

Title: An empty payload is rejected with 500
Test Steps: 1. Send POST /booking with an empty JSON body.
